title: Drake Says He Is Going On Tour In 2023 [Watch]
htmlContent:
Although no official tour announcement was made, Drake recently shared that he was going on tour in 2023 at a Stake livestream appearance with Swedish streamer Twitch Roshtein.

“Ah, man, I can’t wait to see the people, “Drake said.

This tour will be his first since his "Aubrey and The Three Migos Live!" tour in 2018.
In 2022, he gave a unique concert in his home town of Toronto at his annual OVO festival alongside Nicki Minaj and Lil Wayne.

“It’s like one thing to make the music but to see it is the most gratifying feeling,” Drake shared. “It’s different when you’re performing, you look out in the crowd, someone locks eyes with you and you can just tell it’s a moment.”

Tickets and tour information are not yet available for the upcoming 2023 series, but we expect to hear more in the coming weeks.

You can see Drake's official 71-minute conversation, which includes a bit of virtual gaming with Roshtein. The two discuss the tour at length around the 12-minute mark.
